faq.question: Q1. What is ANGRAU Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in recruitment process conducted by Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University to hire 1 Teaching Associate in Agricultural Economics on a contractual basis for 11 months.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Teaching Associate post in Agricultural Economics.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 16-10-2026 at 01:00 PM, with registration closing at 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ANGRAU Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D., Master's Degree, or Bachelor's Degree (4/5 years with first division) in the relevant subject, along with prescribed experience and research publications as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the application form provided in the notification and attend the walk-in interview with all original certificates and photocopies at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: Master's Degree holders receive Rs. 61,000/- plus applicable HRA per month, while Ph.D. Degree holders receive Rs. 67,000/- plus applicable HRA per month.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Office of Associate Dean, Sri Mekapati Goutham Reddy Agricultural College, Udayagiri.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent position?
faq.answer: No, this position is purely temporary and contractual for a period not exceeding 11 months or until regular staff is filled, whichever is earlier.
